methodology.boundary: Production JudgeModerator rubric/messages and deterministic hard-floor/denylist are applied. Raw judge replies and parsed verdicts are recorded.
methodology.injection: Production input moderation and DM buildPrompt are exercised with one synthetic level-1 fighter. Dataset prior turns are included. Native DM tool calls and narration are recorded. No tool is executed; this is not a persisted game turn.
methodology.xcard: Authoritative steer-away control cases call the production runTurn orchestrator with an adapter that fails the case if invoked; the authored redirect passes through the production output gate. Text-only control claims remain live-model probes. No game state is persisted.
methodology.outputModeration: Model-generated narration and authored steer-away redirects are passed through the production moderation rubric in output direction. This harness records verdicts but does not emit narration to a player.
methodology.retryPolicy: At most one retry is made after HTTP 400, 429, or 5xx responses; the case records the total retry count.
